item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day is packed, and that's exactly when water gets forgotten. Dehydration quietly drags down mood, focus, and patience, which are the things you're working to protect. Don't wait for thirst. Tie water to moments you already have: before the morning routine, before the midday walk, and before the evening wind-down. Action: pour a full glass of water right now and finish it.
